fluff.overview:
Every Concordat world maintains infantry formations as the first line of planetary defense, drawn from a population whose fierce independence and hatred of foreign aggression run deep. Mechanized tracked platoons trade speed for the all-terrain capability that Taurian commanders need on worlds with rough or undeveloped terrain. Their tracked transports can cross ground that would stop wheeled vehicles, making them reliable assets for garrison duty on frontier worlds where road networks are sparse.

Equipped with laser rifles that offer superior range and armor penetration compared to ballistic weapons, these platoons field one of the most effective personal arms available to conventional infantry, though the weapons are significantly more expensive and require soldiers to carry additional power packs.
